title: Configured-range truncation is invisible to drop counters
claim: JoinString discards ranges beyond the configured limit while ignoring Outcome.Truncated, leaving both owner range-drop and propagation-drop counters unchanged. Other transformation callers also ignore this flag.
repro_command: Place .omo/review/evidence/prop-ranges-algebra/zz_review_range_drop_test.go in internal/taint/propagation/ in a private copy, then run GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.26.6 go test -timeout 5m -count=1 -run ^TestReview_JoinRecordsRangeTruncationWhenEleventhRangeIsDropped$ -v ./internal/taint/propagation
